_metadata.rules: x02 drafting rules (uncovered words first, no original-50, owner style examples, one-word hints)

clues.wordAConnection: Aladdin rides the Magic Carpet
clues.wordBConnection: Aladdin frees the Genie from the lamp
clues.revealExplanation: Carpet and Genie are both Aladdin's loyal sidekicks.

clues.wordAConnection: Mario is a plumber by trade
clues.wordBConnection: Plumbers work with pipes
clues.revealExplanation: Mario is a plumber, which explains all those green pipes.

clues.wordAConnection: A bishop is a chess piece that moves diagonally
clues.wordBConnection: A bishop is a senior church leader
clues.revealExplanation: The bishop has a job on the chessboard and in the church.

clues.wordAConnection: A giant lives at the top of the beanstalk
clues.wordBConnection: Jack climbs the beanstalk
clues.revealExplanation: Jack climbed the beanstalk and ran into a very grumpy giant.

clues.wordAConnection: Oscar the Grouch lives in a trash can
clues.wordBConnection: An Oscar is Hollywood's most famous trophy
clues.revealExplanation: One Oscar lives in a trash can; the other sits on a mantel.

clues.wordAConnection: A male goat is a billy goat
clues.wordBConnection: Billy the Kid was a famous outlaw
clues.revealExplanation: Billy the Kid meets the billy goat, and a kid is a baby goat too.

clues.wordAConnection: Why did the chicken cross the road?
clues.wordBConnection: The chicken got to the other side of the road
clues.revealExplanation: Why did the chicken cross the road? To get to the other side.

clues.wordAConnection: Godzilla battled Kong on the big screen
clues.wordBConnection: King Kong climbed the Empire State Building
clues.revealExplanation: Kong fought Godzilla and famously scaled a skyscraper.

clues.wordAConnection: Despite his name, Squidward is an octopus
clues.wordBConnection: Squidward is SpongeBob's grumpy neighbor
clues.revealExplanation: Surprise: SpongeBob's neighbor Squidward is an octopus, not a squid.

clues.wordAConnection: Rapunzel has impossibly long hair
clues.wordBConnection: Rapunzel is locked away in a tower
clues.revealExplanation: Rapunzel let down her hair from the tower window.

clues.wordAConnection: The Statue of Liberty stands in New York Harbor
clues.wordBConnection: Lady Liberty holds a torch high
clues.revealExplanation: The Statue of Liberty has held her torch high since 1886.

clues.wordAConnection: Morning dew covers the grass at sunrise
clues.wordBConnection: Mountain Dew is a popular soda
clues.revealExplanation: Dew forms on morning grass and fills cans of Mountain Dew.

clues.wordAConnection: Every keyboard has an Escape key
clues.wordBConnection: Prisoners dream of an escape
clues.revealExplanation: Esc on your keyboard, escape from prison.

clues.wordAConnection: Models strut down the fashion runway
clues.wordBConnection: Planes take off from a runway
clues.revealExplanation: One runway is for supermodels; the other is for jumbo jets.

clues.wordAConnection: Dumbo is the circus's baby elephant
clues.wordBConnection: Dumbo flies using his enormous ears
clues.revealExplanation: Dumbo went from circus outcast to star by flying with his huge ears.

clues.wordAConnection: Jumanji is a magical board game
clues.wordBConnection: Jumanji unleashes the jungle, and one sequel is Welcome to the Jungle
clues.revealExplanation: Roll the dice in Jumanji and the jungle comes to you.

clues.wordAConnection: Smurfs are little blue people
clues.wordBConnection: Smurfs live in mushroom houses
clues.revealExplanation: The Smurfs are blue and live in houses shaped like mushrooms.

clues.wordAConnection: Dory has short-term memory loss
clues.wordBConnection: Dory's motto is "Just keep swimming"
clues.revealExplanation: Dory forgets everything except to just keep swimming.

clues.wordAConnection: Hercules is a son of Zeus, who rules from Mount Olympus
clues.wordBConnection: Hercules is famous for his strength
clues.revealExplanation: Hercules went from zero to hero with legendary strength.

clues.wordAConnection: A horseshoe is a lucky charm
clues.wordBConnection: Lucky the Leprechaun is the Lucky Charms mascot
clues.revealExplanation: Lucky Charms has a leprechaun mascot and horseshoe marshmallows.

clues.wordAConnection: Tony Hawk is the surname that matches
clues.wordBConnection: Tony Hawk is a skateboarding legend
clues.revealExplanation: Tony Hawk made skateboarding famous with the first 900 trick.

clues.wordAConnection: Bigfoot is a legendary forest monster
clues.wordBConnection: Bigfoot was the first monster truck
clues.revealExplanation: Bigfoot is both a mythical monster and the original monster truck.

clues.wordAConnection: Mount Rushmore is a carved mountain in South Dakota
clues.wordBConnection: George Washington's face is carved on Mount Rushmore
clues.revealExplanation: Washington's face is the first of four on Mount Rushmore.

clues.wordAConnection: Peter Piper picked a peck of peppers
clues.wordBConnection: The peppers in the tongue twister were pickled
clues.revealExplanation: Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers. Try saying it fast.

clues.wordAConnection: Peter Piper picked peppers
clues.wordBConnection: Peter Piper's peppers were pickled
clues.revealExplanation: Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers.

clues.wordAConnection: Perry is the platypus in Phineas and Ferb
clues.wordBConnection: Perry is secretly Agent P, a spy
clues.revealExplanation: Perry the Platypus leads a secret life as Agent P.

clues.wordAConnection: A hero is a long sandwich
clues.wordBConnection: A sub is a long sandwich
clues.revealExplanation: Hero or sub, it is the same long sandwich with a different name.

clues.wordAConnection: You browse the internet
clues.wordBConnection: Safari is Apple's web browser
clues.revealExplanation: Safari is a browser, not just an African adventure.

clues.wordAConnection: Ireland is called the Emerald Isle
clues.wordBConnection: The Wizard of Oz lives in the Emerald City
clues.revealExplanation: The Emerald Isle and the Emerald City are both very green.

clues.wordAConnection: The Powerpuff Girls were made with spice
clues.wordBConnection: The Powerpuff Girls were made with sugar
clues.revealExplanation: Sugar, spice, everything nice, and Chemical X made the Powerpuff Girls.

clues.wordAConnection: Acorns grow on oak trees
clues.wordBConnection: Squirrels bury acorns for winter
clues.revealExplanation: Every mighty oak starts as an acorn a squirrel forgot to dig up.

clues.wordAConnection: Hens peck at their food
clues.wordBConnection: A peck is a quick kiss
clues.revealExplanation: A hen pecks for seeds; a peck on the cheek is a little kiss.

clues.wordAConnection: Clowns are masters of slapstick
clues.wordBConnection: A pie in the face is classic slapstick
clues.revealExplanation: Nothing says slapstick like a clown taking a pie to the face.

clues.wordAConnection: Belle falls for the Beast
clues.wordBConnection: The Beast gives book-loving Belle his huge library
clues.revealExplanation: Belle fell for the Beast, and his library sure helped.

clues.wordAConnection: Bill Nye is the first name match
clues.wordBConnection: Bill Nye the Science Guy
clues.revealExplanation: Bill! Bill! Bill! Bill Nye the Science Guy.

clues.wordAConnection: You boil water for tea in a kettle
clues.wordBConnection: A kettle whistles when the water boils
clues.revealExplanation: The kettle whistles to tell you the tea water is ready.

clues.wordAConnection: Gulliver is a giant to the people of Lilliput
clues.wordBConnection: The Lilliputians are tiny
clues.revealExplanation: In Lilliput, ordinary Gulliver was a giant among tiny people.

clues.wordAConnection: Willy Wonka makes candy in his factory
clues.wordBConnection: Golden tickets were hidden in Wonka bars
clues.revealExplanation: Find a golden ticket in a Wonka bar and the factory doors open.

clues.wordAConnection: The New Year's Eve ball drops at midnight
clues.wordBConnection: Cinderella must leave the ball by midnight
clues.revealExplanation: Midnight ends Cinderella's ball and starts the New Year's ball drop.

clues.wordAConnection: The Jungle Book is set in India
clues.wordBConnection: Mowgli is raised in the jungle by wolves
clues.revealExplanation: Mowgli, the boy from The Jungle Book, grew up in the jungles of India.

clues.wordAConnection: Ariel falls for Prince Eric
clues.wordBConnection: Ariel is a mermaid who lives under the sea
clues.revealExplanation: Ariel traded her voice to leave the sea for Prince Eric.
